in_marathi.name: Jayraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘Jaya’ meaning victory and ‘Raja’ meaning ruler. This name signifies a victorious leader, a brave and courageous warrior. In Hindu mythology, Jayraj is also the name of a king in the epic ‘Mahabharata’.
